title: BOSCH: Black-Box Binary Optimization for Short-Context Attention-Head Selection in LLMs
selection_reason: BOSCH selects attention heads by target sliding-window ratio without training and reports better recovery/performance than static head heuristics, a concrete attention-computation optimization.
